scripts.build:all: pnpm build && pnpm build:plugins && pnpm build:cli
scripts.build:plugins: cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/plugins/folder-watcher/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/plugins/imap-watcher/Cargo.toml && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='src-tauri/plugins/bin';fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/folder-watcher.exe',d+'/folder-watcher.exe');fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/imap-watcher.exe',d+'/imap-watcher.exe')"
scripts.build:cli: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='src-tauri/cli/bin';fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});const f=d+'/cc-launcher-cli.exe';if(!fs.existsSync(f))fs.writeFileSync(f,'')" && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin cc-launcher-cli && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/cc-launcher-cli.exe','src-tauri/cli/bin/cc-launcher-cli.exe')"
scripts.hook:final: pnpm ts:typecheck && pnpm ts:lint && pnpm ts:fmt:check && pnpm js:lint && pnpm js:fmt:check && pnpm rs:lint && pnpm rs:fmt:check
